input: Patil et al. (2023) build APIBench from three hubs of machine learning model APIs (TorchHub, TensorHub and HuggingFace) and show Gorilla surpasses GPT-4 there. Critique a claim that these results show Gorilla can call arbitrary real-world APIs, such as web services, equally well.
source: Patil et al. 2023, Abstract and Conclusion (chunks patil2023-000, patil2023-025)
